---
title: "Feedback"
---

Help keep park reports accurate. File feedback as a GitHub Issue on the [EMMA Report](https://github.com/eco-emma/emma_report) repository. A free GitHub account is required; there is no email form on this page.

## How to file

1. Open **[New issue](https://github.com/eco-emma/emma_report/issues/new/choose)** (template chooser).
2. Pick **Data error / incorrect map or graph**, **Feature / future request**, or **General feedback**.
3. Fill the form (park, figure, expected vs observed for data errors). Attach a screenshot when you can.
4. Submit.

If you do not have a GitHub account yet, [create a free account](https://github.com/signup), then return to the template chooser.

## What happens next

The EMMA team reviews issues on GitHub, may ask a follow-up question, and updates the site when a fix ships. Not every request will be built; **data errors are prioritized**. Issues are watched by the EMMA team (`emma_dev`). Maintainers triage work in the org GitHub Project; managers only need the Issues link above.

## What not to submit

- Personal or private landowner details, or GPS of sensitive species beyond what is already public on the map
- Passwords, tokens, private URLs, or vulnerability details (use [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/eco-emma/emma_report/security) if ever needed)

## Data sources

For how products are built and downloaded—and to cite or browse **original sensor and agency sources**—see [Data](data.qmd). This Feedback page is for what you **see on emma.eco**, not for filing tickets against upstream data agencies or pipeline repositories.
